thread history, drafts, model/profile selection and Ask report

agent approval snapshot follows original workspace and file

responsive 1440x900 light dialogs and drawers

layout_measurements.label: resized to desktop with panes closed

limits: Chromium only; no screen-reader, IME, native GTK or real-touch validation.
UI actions are real events; internal snapshots are inspected read-only.
No real Git, compiler, filesystem operations or provider integration is tested.
review_scope: M0 browser fixture evidence only; not native acceptance or user approval

W01.boundary: Partial: no New document or native Find input in this prototype; native palette fixtures not run here.
browser_cases: quick open keyboard navigation, empty results and focus restoration
command palette nested picker, modal focus and Escape
M0 W01 palette editor/search Escape and single keyboard dispatch
M0 W01 unavailable fixture commands are not offered as working

W02.boundary: Not implemented in prototype: simultaneous native panes, independent selection/scroll and undo require native evidence.

W03.boundary: Not implemented in prototype: editable mapped excerpts and historical read-only source require native evidence.

W04.boundary: Partial analogy only: preview save is memory-only. No Save As, canonical paths, FIFO or filesystem race tests here.
browser_cases: typed edits survive tab switching, closing and preview save

W05.boundary: Partial analogy only: one-buffer stale proposal; no multi-document atomic transaction or grouped undo in prototype.
browser_cases: M0 W10 stale proposal remains blocked after real browser undo

W06.boundary: Negative boundary only: reload discards state. No crash recovery, journal, chooser or disk conflict implementation in prototype.
browser_cases: M0 W06 D3 reload resets preview and is not crash recovery

W07.boundary: Partial M0 simulation: root identity, buffers/tabs/search and request targets. Layout is global, not restored per workspace. Full native M2 not implemented here.
browser_cases: workspace isolation, root addition, search and index retention
M0 W07 colliding basenames Unicode search and workspace return
agent approval snapshot follows original workspace and file

W08.boundary: Partial M0 simulation: HEAD/index/buffer invariants. No real repository or external-index invalidation; native M4 not implemented here.
browser_cases: Git whole-file stage and unstage preserve buffer
Git hunk stage, unstage and partial-stage commit
M0 W08 D1 empty index with message never stages or commits

W09.boundary: Partial M0 simulation: explicit read of active buffer, whole canned patch accept/reject. No selection attachment, context picker or per-hunk acceptance; native M6 not implemented here.
browser_cases: agent patch acceptance updates buffer but not HEAD, index or save
agent patch rejection changes no snapshots
M0 W09 D2 proposal is inert through permission review and reject

W10.boundary: Partial M0 simulation: permission, local timer cancellation, revisions and original target. No streamed partial responses, provider execution or ACP; native M6/M7 not implemented here.
browser_cases: agent denial captures no buffer and changes nothing
agent cancellation before approval
agent cancellation during approved read survives timer
agent stale patch blocks acceptance and preserves real typing
typing during approved read produces stale result without focus loss
background thread patch invalidates after buffer typing
agent approval snapshot follows original workspace and file
M0 W10 stale proposal remains blocked after real browser undo
M0 W10 D4 narrow light permission deny cancel review artifacts

W11.boundary: Negative boundary only: terminal is canned. M0 native PTY/widget spike needs separate evidence; full native M5 not implemented here.
browser_cases: terminal fixtures, unsupported command notice and panel keyboard

W12.boundary: Not implemented: no ACP fake peer, negotiation, stream, disconnect or adapter fixture in this browser suite. Native M7 remains separate.

D1.boundary: Staged-only design exercised in memory; product approval not recorded.
browser_cases: Git hunk stage, unstage and partial-stage commit
M0 W08 D1 empty index with message never stages or commits

D2.boundary: Inert-until-accept policy exercised in memory; not process containment. Product approval not recorded.
browser_cases: M0 W09 D2 proposal is inert through permission review and reject
M0 W10 stale proposal remains blocked after real browser undo
agent denial captures no buffer and changes nothing
agent cancellation during approved read survives timer

D3.boundary: Prototype deliberately has no recovery/checkpoint promise; native recovery tests linked, not executed. Product approval not recorded.
browser_cases: M0 W06 D3 reload resets preview and is not crash recovery

D4.boundary: Offline/native-scope disclosures reviewed; appearance is a browser concept, not GTK parity or provider ownership implementation. Product approval not recorded.

branch picker is explicitly label-only
terminal fixtures, unsupported command notice and panel keyboard
